Hero_Desc_Allet:
The youngest staff sergeant of the Monatium Suppression Unit.
A dedicated soldier who will carry out any of Canna's orders.
Her only flaw is that she does not listen to Elena or Amelia, both of whom outrank Kanna.
Album_Allet1: Allet admires Chief Canna. She constantly tries to relate her entire life to Canna.
Album_Allet2: Allet takes as much pride in the Suppression Unit, that her and Chief Canna belong to, as much as she respects the chief. She confidently claims it's the coolest and strongest division in Monatium.
Album_Allet3: Allet doesn't listen to Elena and Amelia. Canna must always mediate between them. Every time Elena tries giving Allet a direct order, she flat-out refuses, which just drives her up the wall.
Album_Allet4: Even Allet, who seems to be a model Suppression Unit member, occasionally breaks the rules. She sometimes eats outside designated areas and sneaks away rations to hoard them
Album_Allet5: Allet approaches every task with enthusiasm. However, she sometimes makes big mistakes. Whenever this happens, she gets called in and scolded by Chief Canna, but there are rumors that she can't help herself but flash a smile in her presence...
Album_Allet6: Allet suddenly mentions she would look for 'Canna' in another village. When the others wonder what she means, it turns out that in Allet's mind, 'Canna' has become synonymous with an admirable mentor. Allet later reports that despite searching extensively in the villages of other races, she can't find another 'Canna'.
Album_Allet7: Once I told Allet about the insurgency in the Sprite Kingdom, her eyes turned frighteningly intense. Right in front of me, she spent quite a while plotting to install Canna as the new mayor and overthrow Elena. After a long time convincing her that Canna herself wouldn't want it, I barely managed to also stop her from submitting a 131-page insurgency proposal.
LoveHero_Allet:
I'm ready!
Just give the word!
LoveHeroCancel_Allet:
If there's something you need...
please let me know!
Food_ChefNote_Allet_Hate1: It is said to resemble the least appetizing soup served during the Suppression Unit's mealtime.
Food_ChefNote_Allet_Hate2: Apparently, it tastes better when prepared separately. Allet seems to be averse to eating it straight from the can.
Food_ChefNote_Allet_Like1: When eating this snack during work hours, it supposedly alleviates boredom.
Food_ChefNote_Allet_Like2: Allet may be always eating this, and yet, somehow, she always craves it.
Food_ChefNote_Allet_Like3: She finishes the entire dish, saying this heartwarming food lifts her spirits with every bite.
Food_ChefNote_Allet_Like4: She slowly savors the dessert, saying she can very much tell this is special treat.
Food_ChefNote_Allet_Like5: Saying this was a portable and convenient snack, she put it in a bag.
Food_ChefNote_Allet_Like6: At first, she found the texture off-putting but grew to enjoy the taste the more she ate it.
Food_ChefNote_Allet_Like7: She loved it, saying it tastes similar to a popular snack sold at the Suppression Unit PX.
Food_ChefNote_Allet_Like8: She drinks this her own way, claiming it turns into a delicious juice when mixed with water.
Food_ChefNote_Allet_Like9: Looking at the elf-shaped candy, she seems proud to be recognized as a part of Elias.
Gacha_Result_Line1_Allet: Everything's been updated with my new address!
Allet_Defeat2: I'll get to writing up that formal letter of apology.
Allet_Affinity1_2: The Chief's orders matter more than the mayor's...
Allet_Affinity5: Should I discreetly order some provisions?
Allet_Affinity7: Does the Order follow proper promotion procedures?
Allet_Touch1_2: Uhm, if this is part of training, then...
Allet_Touch2: I, I'll lose discipline like this!
Allet_Touch2_2: Hehe, it feels good today too!
Allet_No2: That is not the case, sir!
Allet_Birthday: Happy birthday! I brought some snacks from the PX.
LoveLetter_Allet: Master, good day! Allet here from the Monatium Suppression Unit.It feels odd writing you for personal reasons, given that I usually only communicate for official matters.The purpose of my letter is to express my gratitude.Your leadership and willingness to take charge in every situation are qualities I hold in the highest regard. Oh, of course, Chief Canna also is someone I hold in the highest regard... Oh, this is tough!In any case, should anything troublesome occur in Monatium, please let me know.I'll do my best to help, as always! With loyalty, Allet
LoveCall_Allet:
Communications secure! Master, is now a good time to talk?!
Huh? How am I calling at this hour?
It's a rare day off, so I thought it'd be even better if I could spend it with you, Master!
...Ah... o-of course... assuming my leave doesn't get canceled.

Oh, right! The Suppression Unit is about to watch a movie together. Have you seen anything good, Master?
Tell us the title and we'll look it up... Huh?
Hey! I said I'd just make a call and then come over! Why'd you start without me?!
Ah... M-Master, I'm sorry! I'll call you again next time! Loyalty!!
Affinity_Allet_EP01_001: It's meal time! I'm curious about today's menu!
Affinity_Allet_EP01_002: Wait a moment. I will show you the ultimate taste.
Affinity_Allet_EP01_003: Master! I trust you second only to Chief Canna!
Affinity_Allet_EP01_004: Today's menu is a special hardtack.
Affinity_Allet_EP01_005: Ha-hardtack.... *Sob* No, it's nothing. I like hardtack.
Affinity_Allet_EP01_006: Can I tell Canna that you are here for food?
Affinity_Allet_EP01_007: Urgh... Ye-yes, you can. I can't lie to chief or to make a secret.
Affinity_Allet_EP02_001: Master, you seem to have big interest in food.
Affinity_Allet_EP02_002: Yeah. I like food. What food does Allet like?
Affinity_Allet_EP02_003: Pizza, cutlet, spaghetti, dumplings, steak, chicken... I think, but I'm not sure. I've only eaten food that's been processed into blocks.
Affinity_Allet_EP02_004: What do you think about mint chocolate, cucumbers, and pineapple-topped bread?
Affinity_Allet_EP02_005: Oh... That's a sensitive question. I don't reject any food. A soldier shouldn't complain about food.
Affinity_Allet_EP02_006: All the food in this world has its unique taste. I eat everything.
Affinity_Allet_EP02_007: I knew it, that's our Master. I like eating too.
Affinity_Allet_EP03_001: Meluna sent fresh melons, so I brought some.
Affinity_Allet_EP03_002: Oh. They look delicious. Give me a few more.
Affinity_Allet_EP03_003: Ugh... Those are my precious snacks... One... two... is that enough?
Affinity_Allet_EP03_004: They would be perfect for melon bocconcini.
Affinity_Allet_EP03_005: Melon bocconcini made of these melons... Just imagining it seems delicious.
Affinity_Allet_EP03_007: Me? No way! Meluna gave melons to all the Suppression Unit members!
Affinity_Allet_EP04_001: To supress enemies, I have to keep my body strong! So I need to eat well!
Affinity_Allet_EP04_003: Of course, I have to be. If I collapse, it would stain the reputation of the Suppression Unit and the Chief.
Affinity_Allet_EP04_004: Aren't you just an elf who wants to eat a lot?
Affinity_Allet_EP04_007: Don't say such things while I'm eating!
Affinity_Allet_EP05_001: Urgh! I'm covered in dirt! Is there a water hose anywhere? I want to wash the dirt off.
Affinity_Allet_EP05_002: Umm... You didn't buried someone, right?
Affinity_Allet_EP05_003: That's a restricted information due to operational reasons.
Affinity_Allet_EP05_005: I often chop down trees, but I don't usually plant them.
Affinity_Allet_EP05_006: Restaurants must be clean. Shake off the dirt out there before entering.
Affinity_Allet_EP05_007: M-M-My apologies. I'll correct it immediately!
Affinity_Allet_EP06_001: If there is trouble in the Banquet Hall, call me. I'll supress anything.
Affinity_Allet_EP06_002: So reliable, Allet. I'm so proud of you!
Affinity_Allet_EP06_003: It's nothing for a member of the Monatium Suppression Unit.
Affinity_Allet_EP06_004: Just hit them. It's more complicated to officially challenge someone.
Affinity_Allet_EP06_005: It-it can't be! The chief would never do anything to be suppressed!
Affinity_Allet_EP06_006: Very good. Difficult customers, wait for me...
Affinity_Allet_EP06_007: How dare they disturb the precious dining space, I promise I'll protect here no matter what.
Affinity_Allet_EP07_001: Chief Canna requested to deliver five bowls of rice cake soup to the Monatium Arcade.
Affinity_Allet_EP07_002: We don't have delivery service. Get back.
Affinity_Allet_EP07_003: Urgh. If I fail this mission, the Suppression Unit's honor will fall...! Please give me just one bowl!
Affinity_Allet_EP07_004: I think bringing food outside might upset Elena.
Affinity_Allet_EP07_005: Even if Miss Elena doesn't like it, I'll prioritize the chief's orders first.
Affinity_Allet_EP07_006: Why did she request delivery from you, Allet, instead of Shoupan?
Affinity_Allet_EP07_007: It's because the chief trusts me the most!
Affinity_Allet_EP08_001: What kind of exercise do you like, Master?
Affinity_Allet_EP08_003: You breathe through those huge nostrils. That could be some sort of exercise too.
Affinity_Allet_EP08_004: What exercise do you like, Allet?
Affinity_Allet_EP08_005: I focus on gross muscle training to handle shields and shovels easily.
Affinity_Allet_EP08_006: You know what? I used to lift 500 kg in three exercises.
Affinity_Allet_EP08_007: ...That's hard to believe. No, I'm not doubting you, just saying it's amazing!
Affinity_Allet_EP09_001: The results of the Monatium election are in. Miss Elena will continue her term as mayor.
Affinity_Allet_EP09_002: How many terms has Elena had?
Affinity_Allet_EP09_003: 1,2,3,4,5... I gave up counting after five, so I don't know!
Affinity_Allet_EP09_006: Allet, did you vote for Elena?
Affinity_Allet_EP09_007: I got two ballots, so I vote one for Miss Elena and one for the chief. Hehehe.
Affinity_Allet_EP10_001: A stray puppy wandered into the unit recently, and we are currently taking it.
Affinity_Allet_EP10_003: Yes. Dogs are loyal. They suit me well.
Affinity_Allet_EP10_004: What are you feeding the dog?
Affinity_Allet_EP10_006: Are you sure you're properly taking care of it?
Affinity_Allet_EP10_007: If I decide to do something, I do it deligently no matter what!
Affinity_Allet_EP11_001: Today... I went on a ruck march today...
Affinity_Allet_EP11_002: How many kilos did you carry?
Affinity_Allet_EP11_003: I loaded an extra 5kg on top of the 40kg pack...
Affinity_Allet_EP11_004: Oh my. Did something go wrong?
Affinity_Allet_EP11_005: Ugh. I-I can't say! That I would make such a mistake... It's embarassing!
Affinity_Allet_EP11_006: Want a bowl of white rice? Eat up and get your strength back.
Affinity_Allet_EP11_007: *Sob* Thank you...! As expected, there's only you, Master.
Affinity_Allet_EP12_003: I caught a cold... I don't want to infect the other elves in the suppression squad.
Affinity_Allet_EP12_004: Have you come here to volunteer as a slave?
Affinity_Allet_EP12_005: My only superior is Chief Canna.
Affinity_Allet_EP12_006: What exactly do you think my Banquet Hall is.
Affinity_Allet_EP12_007: I may not honor you as much as our Chief, but I do respect you.
Affinity_Allet_EP13_001: After finishing training and taking a refreshing bath, I feel alive. Phew.
Affinity_Allet_EP13_002: Banana milk is the best after a bath.
Affinity_Allet_EP13_003: Oh? If I order it, will you make it for me?
Affinity_Allet_EP13_004: It'd be even better if you went to Ifrit's sauna and got roasted there.
Affinity_Allet_EP13_005: A soldier can't leave their post that far.
Affinity_Allet_EP13_006: Then it's time to work up a sweat again.
Affinity_Allet_EP13_007: Wh-what are you going to make me do.
Affinity_Allet_EP14_001: Today I caught one of my peers slacking off! I crushed her!
Affinity_Allet_EP14_003: I reported it to my superior, so she must be getting punished right now, no?
Affinity_Allet_EP14_005: A soldier who neglects their duty lowers the prestige of the suppression squad. I protected the prestige of the suppression squad!
Affinity_Allet_EP14_006: Your sense of justice is truly commendable, Allet. You should make arrests within the Order too.
Affinity_Allet_EP14_007: Understood! I'll start right now! Hold out your hands!
Affinity_Allet_EP15_001: I heard there's a secret space hidden underground in the Yggdrasil Order.
Affinity_Allet_EP15_002: Yeah. It's a scary place where you never know what might come out.
Affinity_Allet_EP15_003: Don't worry. Whatever comes out, I'll handle it for you!
Affinity_Allet_EP15_005: As expected, you know something, Master...
Affinity_Allet_EP15_006: Why? Are the elves interested in that too?
Affinity_Allet_EP15_007: I'm not sure about the mayor, but the Chief definitely has no interest in it nor even thinks about it.
Affinity_Allet_EP16_001: These days, after seeing how Layze has been doing, I started using Elfnet and I really lose track of time.
Affinity_Allet_EP16_002: You've never used Elfnet before. Are you for real?
Affinity_Allet_EP16_003: To fulfill my duty as a soldier, I've been focusing on physical training, so I haven't had time for personal matters!
Affinity_Allet_EP16_005: Indeed, time flies by in the blink of an eye...
Affinity_Allet_EP16_006: You're an elf, so you're not computer illiterate, right?
Affinity_Allet_EP16_007: Due to the specifics of my job, I'm used to solving things physically.
Affinity_Allet_EP17_001: I want to touch the fur of an animal called an alpaca. I heard it's incredibly soft and fluffy.
Affinity_Allet_EP17_003: Yes. It feels like all the fatigue of the day just melts away.
Affinity_Allet_EP17_004: Alpacas are cute and have a good personality too.
Affinity_Allet_EP17_005: Ooh. Have you met one? A good personality makes it a perfect animal.
Affinity_Allet_EP17_006: I'll draw you a cute alpaca instead.
Affinity_Allet_EP18_001: I recently heard that books are food for the soul.
Affinity_Allet_EP18_002: That's a good saying. Read books to enrich your soul.
Affinity_Allet_EP18_003: My physical nourishment ends with hardtack, and now I have to worry about nourishment for my soul too?
Affinity_Allet_EP18_004: Who did you hear that from?
Affinity_Allet_EP18_005: On the way to the Banquet Hall, I heard a phantom called Rim say that a dense book is something to really chew on.
Affinity_Allet_EP18_006: Books are good for the mind. You can fall sound asleep while reading.
Affinity_Allet_EP18_007: They can do that? I already fall asleep as soon as my head hits the pillow, so they'd be useless for me.
Affinity_Allet_EP19_001: Ugh! I ate too fast and feel like throwing up! P-Please give me some digestive medicine!
Affinity_Allet_EP19_003: The Chief called for me! I can't keep her waiting!
Affinity_Allet_EP19_005: Ugh... My salary's already pathetic as it is...
Affinity_Allet_EP19_006: At that point, medicine won't help. The bathroom's that way.
Affinity_Allet_EP20_001: I came in dead last at the suppression unit's doll shooting competition...
Affinity_Allet_EP20_002: How can a soldier not know how to shoot?
Affinity_Allet_EP20_004: Try harder next time and win me a doll.
Affinity_Allet_EP20_005: Sorry, but the first doll I win is going to the Chief!
Affinity_Allet_EP20_006: The suppression squad sure knows how to have fun.
Affinity_Allet_EP20_007: It's not fun! It's part of our extremely rigorous training regimen!
